notes.title: Medium Update V1.0.8
notes.content: [p]Hey fellow adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]Greetings! We're excited to announce that version 1.0.8 is launching soon. This update brings several major optimizations and new features designed to make your underground adventures more flexible and enjoyable.[/p][p] [/p][p]Update Overview[/p][p]\[Sandbox Mode Launch][/p][p]Ÿ The new Sandbox Mode is now live! We've removed the main story and quest restrictions, giving you complete freedom to explore, adventure, and build your own unique underground realm.[/p][p] [/p][p]\[System and Gameplay Improvements][/p][p]Ÿ Logistics Transport Tower streamlining: We've simplified Logistics Transport Tower operations and reduced their costs, making resource management much easier.[/p][p]Ÿ Story skip option: Added the ability to skip cutscenes, so you can dive straight into exploration and construction at your own pace.[/p][p]Ÿ Build Mode overhaul:[/p][p]- Place buildings directly from your Backpack for smoother gameplay[/p][p]- New click-and-drag functionality lets you rapidly place multiple structures, dramatically speeding up construction[/p][p]Ÿ Planting Zone marking system: Craft the "Farmland Designator" at your Crafting Table to mark individual farmland and assign specific crops to your Monster Girls, giving you precise control over your agricultural operations.[/p][p] [/p][p]We're committed to listening to our community's feedback and continuously improving the game experience. Thank you for your ongoing support - we can't wait for you to experience everything the new version has to offer![/p][p] [/p][p]Happy adventuring![/p]

notes.title: Major Update V0.6.0513 New Version Level 7 "The Deep Sea"
notes.content:
In the vast undersea world, countless unknowns and mysteries waving an uncharted area. Ancient life and modern creatures coexist, what’s the story of monster girls from this level?

Dear inner-earth explorers, we are excited to announce that new version Level 7:      
The Deep Sea is officially launched today! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/1567a157c827d9627066044ecaa6d32fa2cc0413.png[/img]
Here are the update details:

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Map: Core Level 7 - Brand new submarine world!
[*] New Minerals: Tungsten, Gold 
[*] New Monster Girl: Ariel
[*] New Map Boss: Trench Lord - Leviathan
[*] New Equipments: Harpoon Pickaxe, Anchor Pickaxe, Merman set, etc.;
[*] New Dishes: Stewed Meat with Kelp, Ants Climbing a Tree, Sea Pearl Elixir, etc.;
[*] New Plants: Kelp, Coral, Pearl Grass, etc.; 
[*] New Material: Refined Crystal · Orange
[*] New Machine: Advanced Storage
[*] New furniture: Ocean furniture series, etc.;
[*] New Tech: Fish Farming, pick up your fishing rod and start farming after catching fish!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/6d82c4b51df4d352aaa016e80805b9b31d4774d6.png[/img]
[h2]System Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Monster Girl cooking has evolved! 
You can now set a target dish for Monster Girl to cook on the Cooking Pot page, and if there are enough ingredients, the dish will be prepared first;
[*] Monster Girl farming has evolved! 
Monster Girl will now have smarter farming AI, which will multiply the efficiency of farming;
[*] Monster Girl will slowly recover HP when she returns to camp;
[*] Recipe saving optimization.
When players create new food, the recipe will be saved automatically.
[*] Optimized animation rendering and logic operation efficiency. Smoothness has been significantly improved!
[*] Added a new function to monitor the total amount of items on the conveyor belt. 
Items of the same type will be automatically merged when they exceed the limit, reducing lag;
[/list]
Thank you again for your support and affirmation, in the future, we will continue to move forward, enrich the game content, optimize the game experience, and strive to bring you a more exciting and exciting adventure!
[url=https://discord.gg/M74MdB5c]Discord[/url]

Tanxun Studio & 2P Games

notes.title: Return from Core - Game Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear explorer,

Development for Level 7 is mostly finished, and we're currently in the final stages of testing and optimization, striving to deliver the best possible exploration experience for you all! 
We're planning to release the major update for Layer 7 during the Creature Collecting Game Festival, which kicks off on May 13th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/6d82c4b51df4d352aaa016e80805b9b31d4774d6.png[/img]
Furthermore, the development team is already hard at work pushing forward with the production of Level 8. Stay tuned for more updates!

Meanwhile, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your ongoing support and invaluable feedback. As we prepared Level 7, we identified some issues in the current version that are impacting the gameplay experience. Rather than rushing out new content, we've decided to prioritize optimizing our current systems to ensure a more stable and complete gaming experience for everyone when Level 7 launches.

Here's what's included in this update:

I. World Creation Upgrade
New Difficulty & World Options System
· Customize world parameters to create your own adventure playground!
· Whether seeking extreme challenges or casual exploration, find your perfect gaming experience.


II. Character System Revamp
Profession System
· Choose different professions during character creation. Each profession offers unique skills, adding strategic depth to your adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/b85affb8a3c51dbf910e10281f7c05503bc5fa85.png[/img]

III. Camp System Improvements
Enhanced Camp System
· Unified design of Camps, Super Drill, and Cabin for clearer game objectives.
· Cross-camp and cross-level logistics
· Efficiently transfer resources between Camps using Camp Warehouse, Monster Girl transportation abilities, and automated production lines
· Fast Travel Feature
· Rapidly move between camps, saying goodbye to unnecessary long journeys!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/cfa6b643a82d68dac0703d1fad30751604955ff6.png[/img]

IV. Monster Girl Cooperation System Improvements
More convenient task delegation for Monster Girls to create your ideal, efficiently-running camp.
· Monster Girl Combat Feature!
· Take up to 3 Monster Girls with you on adventures, where they can equip items and unleash their unique abilities!
· Monster Girl Enhancement System: Collect resources to strengthen attributes and unlock powerful combat skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/714b3d53386cccb8684d1170dbb26b319458fb71.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/7e0cbe5fa5bf7b66922f7d96aa0a65b72ee22243.png[/img]

V. System Improvements
1. Simplified Super Drill System: Streamlined design with clearer objectives and smoother user experience
2. Automated Production Line Improvements:
· Added key buildings like Logistics Transport Tower
· Expanded mid and high-level production recipes, significantly increasing the endgame potential of automation systems!
· Enhanced synergy between automation, Monster Girl cooperation, and inter-camp operations
· Early Main Quests Restructured: Improved early-game progression for a smoother overall experience
· Improved System Guides: Enhanced tutorials for various systems, making the game more accessible for newcomers
· Save Recovery Mechanism: New save history feature allows rollback to prevent save corruption issues
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/f69b1d32272d4ee44e86b9fd38b4321c22429cc2.png[/img]

Thank you, explorers, for your continued support of "Return from Core"!
[url=https://discord.gg/sgKzPmHq]Discord[/url]

Tanxun Studio & 2P Games

Happy Chinese New Year! Special Update V0.4.1.0124
notes.content:
Happy Chinese New Year, inner earth adventurers!
As firecrackers bid farewell to the old year and snow foretells a bountiful harvest, we extend our heartfelt gratitude and warmest wishes to all the explorers who have accompanied Journey from Core on its journey of growth. During this festive season of reunion and joy, we’re thrilled to present the 2025 Chinese New Year Special Update.

[h1]Festival Events[/h1]
[list]
[*] Core Town Revamp: Giant lanterns and festive decorations now adorn Core Town, ushering in the New Year!
[*] Midnight Red Envelope Hunt: At 12:00 AM each night, visit the Dragon Lantern in Core Town to receive a Lunar New Year Red Envelope packed with generous rewards!
[*] Lunar New Year Recipes: Enjoy the delicious additions of Rice Cake and Spring Roll—recipes will unlock on the fourth level of the Core.
[*] Exclusive Festival Furniture: Add warmth to your home with the Lunar New Year Double Bed and Lunar New Year Chair, obtainable through red envelopes.
[*] Exclusive Decorations: Collect Paper Cutouts (Fortune, Dragon), Prosperity Painting, Spring Vase, and New Year Potted Plant from map chests or red envelopes!
[*] Festive Bonding: Gift Lunar New Year items to monster girls to increase affection and unlock more interactions!
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Monster Girl Log: Easily track the progress of your monster girls' tasks!
[*] Boss Detector: Locate bosses with the new detector tool.
[*] Crafting Station Overhaul: Merged the crafting table and advanced crafting table into one for streamlined crafting.
[*] Drill Transport Simplification: Simplified cross-layer transport mechanics; cabins now support cross-layer transportation.
[*] Enhanced Guides: Added clearer instructions for drill and signal tower use.
[*] Power Grid Optimization: Improved connection mechanics for the power grid.
[*] Drill Upgrades: Increased cabin capacity and cross-layer warehouse capacity through upgrades.
[*] Production Improvements: Expanded machine capacity to resolve production bottlenecks.
[*] Automation Enhancements: Increased automation complexity for mid-to-high layers.
[*] Merchant Expansion: Vendors now offer a wider variety of items.
[*] Cooking Buffs: Each ingredient and dish now has unique buff effects, and material requirements for cooking have been reduced.
[*] Weapon Balancing: Boosted stats and effects for higher-rarity weapons.
[*] New Animations: Added kill and death animations, along with death cause explanations.
[*] Transition Effects: Added smoother transitions when entering caves or using portable drills.
[*] Visual Indicators: Improved visuals for low health and hunger states.
[*] Health Bar Effects: Introduced a smoother health bar animation.
[*] Rarity Frames: Items now display frames based on their rarity.
[*] Ammo Display: Cannons now show remaining ammo.
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the delivery command station not transporting or losing items and causing crashes.
[*] Fixed some bugs when items overload in production machines.
[*] Fixed a bug where items will lose during cross-layer transport via super drill.
[*] Fixed a bug where monster girls couldn’t work as assigned.
[*] Fixed missing information markers in some quests.
[*] Fixed the inability to obtain certain items (e.g., arcade machines and fishing chairs).
[*] Fixed missing or non-functional attributes in equipment and set effects.
[*] Fixed bugs when mining nearby ores.
[*] Fixed missing item prompts for collected gravestones.
[*] Balanced excessive damage from certain traps.
[*] Fixed map data generation errors.
[*] Fixed a movement issue after starting the game (required dodging to move).
[*] Fixed inability to delete work areas.
[*] Fixed a bug where drill cabin walls that could be mined.
[/list]

In the new year, we’ll continue to enrich game content, optimize mechanics, and bring you an even more exciting adventure! Thank you for your support, and have a fantastic Lunar New Year!

notes.title: Christmas Special Update V0.2.1.1224
notes.content:
Hello Inner Earth’s Creatures!

Merry Christmas! TanXun Studio and 2P Games extends our sincerest thanks and best wishes to every adventurer who has accompanied us on this journey.

Your enthusiasm and support have ignited our creative flame, bringing life and vitality to the virtual world of this game. Every gathering, every battle, and every step of exploration you take is the greatest encouragement for us. 

To thank everyone for their support over the past year and to celebrate the Christmas holidays, we present the "Christmas Special Update" today!

[h1]New Contents：[/h1]

1、New Appearance for Core Town
Core Town will be decorated in Christmas theme.

2、Christmas Tree and Gifts
A huge Christmas tree has appeared in the Core Town. During Christmas, there will be a secret gift around the Christmas tree for everyone at 0’clock every day.

3、Christmas exclusive pickaxe
Frozen Candy Pickaxe. It looks like a candy cane, which can be claimed in Secret Gift.

4、Christmas Cooking
Added “Christmas Pudding”, “Teddy Bear Cookie”, “Winter Sweet Wine” as Christmas special recipe, which can be unlocked when reach to Core Level 4.

5、Christmas Furniture
Added “Christmas Table”, “Christmas Chair”, “Small Christmas Tree”, “Edelweiss Carpet”, which can be claimed in Secret Gift.

6、Christmas Decorations
Added “Frozen Slime Sculpture”, “Grandpa Christmas Tree Sculpture”, “Frost Ant Sculpture”, “Ice Silk Spider Sculpture” 4 festival special sculpture, which can be dropped from monsters or claimed in Secret Gift.

7、Christmas Sleigh
During Christmas, the model of mining cart will be changed to Sleigh.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/9a0b234b033af8a6ca1da3e72799e67f744cd2e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/ee8a6a7b901d99e5e365bd4c11336225438190b5.jpg[/img]

This Christmas special event will end on January 24th.

notes.title: Minor Update V0.2.1.1210b
Minor Update V0.2.1.1206
Major Update (November)
About Upcoming Major Update
notes.content:
Hello Inner Earth’s Creatures!

In the past two months, thanks to the assistance of all players, we have fixed many issues in the game and updated some content to optimize the gaming experience. Subsequently, we have devoted more energy to developing the follow-up content of the game, which will be updated this Friday.

In the new version，we have added support for controllers. We have also introduced a large amount of new gameplay content, including new ore resources, weapons, equipment, and building items. Additionally, we have added several new character attributes and made comprehensive adjustments to the talent tree.

The monster girl will also receive significant enhancements. They will assist players in completing various complex tasks after joining the player's camp. Furthermore, we have completely restructured the automation technology gameplay features, making the entire production process of the game clearer and more concise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/7ef001951eca5041fb3c6dca578dc3648196933e.png[/img]

It is important to note that in this update, we have added a world save feature. Character data will be separated from world data, allowing characters to enter other world saves to continue playing. This will also support players entering other people's worlds in the subsequent multiplayer mode. However, due to a large number of content feature upgrades and adjustments to the map generation mechanism, there have been many conflicts between the old save data and the new version content. Despite trying various methods, we still cannot make them compatible. Therefore, after the new version update, everyone will need to start playing with a new save.

We understand that this experience, which is akin to a data wipe, greatly affects the experience of all players. However, in order for the subsequent features and gameplay of the game to proceed smoothly, we have no choice but to make this difficult decision, and we sincerely apologize for this. 

We expect to push this update this Friday, and the specific update content will be released in a subsequent update announcement. We are also continuously receiving player feedback and suggestions, and will adjust the direction of development accordingly, hoping to provide a better gaming experience for all players. If you encounter any issues during the game or have some interesting suggestions, you can join the official[url=https://discord.gg/hkBZCumz] Discord [/url]below to communicate and provide feedback with us.

Tanxun Studio & 2P Games

notes.title: RETURN FROM CORE SEEKS FUNDING ON KICKSTARTER
notes.content:
2P Games and Tanxun Studio announce that its survival sandbox adventure, Return From Core, has just launched a Kickstarter campaign to gather additional funding to not only wrap up the game’s release but also look for opportunities to add new features, quests, characters or even port to other platforms. The game will be released in Steam Early Access in 2023. In Return From Core, players have to dig for materials to craft new gear and defend their camp against the creatures and perils of the Core.

[b]Kickstarter Page[/b]：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/returnfromcore/return-from-core-exploring-the-mysterious-inner-earth]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/returnfromcore/return-from-core-exploring-the-mysterious-inner-earth[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/0b007fecc40762aa7dd0e82278dbbf827a74f430.png[/img]

[b]ABOUT THE GAME[/b]

Return From Core is a survival sandbox adventure that throws players into the Inner Earth, a world within a world where the main character seeks shelter after the catastrophe that left the surface as a wasteland and shattered all signs of civilization. Exploring a vast array of treacherous caves and tunnels will give you the tools to survive in an unforgiving environment. But who knows if, during your expeditions, you will find the knowledge and technology that one day, hopefully, will let you return to the surface to start a new life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/981f7a7e732f0442b9e0488f73211513ce2ecebe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/27fb477bb0ba27f312ea2f120a834854846ebb06.png[/img]

[b]KEY FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Explore the underground world with you trusty pickaxe and a lantern. Gather materials to craft new gear, weapons and much more... but beware of the dangers that lie ahead.
[*] Build your camp and decorate it with your DIY furniture. Everybody needs a safe place to return to after a hard work's day!
[*] Fight the creatures of Inner Earth. You are not alone and these creatures aren't gonna let you trespass their realm. Craft powerful weapons, bombs, and traps, defeat them and get rich rewards.
[*] Build automated production lines. Once you discover lost technologies and gather better materials you will be able to build automated production lines to improve the materials you get and the items you craft.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43271912/b645a212b1939fddff8068c17ac3f29d13a7a701.png[/img]
